initial_scene: In a forward-looking robot camera view, both forearms extend from the near side of the table. A tall translucent red glass stands upright near the center-left and a blue plate lies to its right. The left hand is open and raised; the right hand is open near the plate.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands initially hold position; the glass is upright on the table and the blue plate is empty.
The right arm moves inward from beside the plate toward the red glass with thumb and fingers spread; the left hand remains raised and does not touch the object.
The right fingers close around the sides of the red glass; the glass shifts slightly toward the hand as its grasp is secured.
The right hand lifts the glass and carries it rightward toward the blue plate, rotating it from upright toward horizontal.
The glass is brought across the blue plate and lowered while held sideways, with its open rim facing left and base near the right hand.
The right fingers spread, and the glass rolls or settles onto its side across the plate; the hand stays beside its base at the ending.
